definition_or_construction: Economy identifier for the 23 included economies
notes: Exact identifiers and mapping to source files should be checked against the pipeline

definition_or_construction: Calendar month of the monthly observation
source_or_derivation: Study CPI panel / published shock series
notes: Monthly range January 2000–December 2025 for historical analysis

definition_or_construction: Headline consumer price index for economy i in calendar month t
notes: Licensed vendor-supplied observations are not deposited

definition_or_construction: 100 × ln(CPI_i,t)
notes: CPI series must be strictly positive

definition_or_construction: 100 × (ln(CPI_i,t) − ln(CPI_i,t−1))
notes: Not the same as 12-month year-over-year inflation

definition_or_construction: Local projection response horizon h
notes: Separate LP regression for each horizon

definition_or_construction: 100 × (ln(CPI_i,t+h) − ln(CPI_i,t−1))
notes: At h=0 equals contemporaneous monthly log CPI change; not a monthly inflation rate at h>0

definition_or_construction: Published monthly VAR-identified oil supply news shock associated with Känzig (2021)
source_or_derivation: Känzig (2021) published monthly oil supply news series
verification_status: Source and measure documented; exact column pending
notes: Not the high-frequency OPEC announcement instrument; sign retained as published

definition_or_construction: (published_news_t − historical mean) / historical standard deviation computed over 2000–2025
verification_status: Documented in manuscript; exact SD convention pending
notes: Check sample-vs-population SD convention and any missing-month handling in original pipeline

definition_or_construction: Lagged monthly domestic inflation inflation_i,t−j for j=1,...,12
notes: Six-lag and eighteen-lag variations appear in sensitivity analyses

definition_or_construction: Lagged standardized oil supply news news_z,t−j for j=1,...,12
notes: Controls for previous shock innovations

definition_or_construction: Economy fixed effects
notes: Pooled slope does not necessarily equal equal-weight mean of country slopes

definition_or_construction: Calendar month-of-year effects
notes: Distinct from full calendar-date fixed effects

definition_or_construction: Full year-month calendar-date fixed effects
notes: Absorbs main effect of common news series; not included in baseline pooled model

definition_or_construction: Historical average baseline log aggregate GDP for economy i over 2000–2004, standardized across economies
verification_status: Broad method documented; source release pending
notes: Verify whether mean of logs or log of mean was used in exact pipeline

definition_or_construction: Historical average baseline log GDP per capita for economy i over 2000–2004, standardized across economies
verification_status: Broad method documented; source release pending
notes: Verify normalization and price basis in exact pipeline

definition_or_construction: Current standardized news shock multiplied by predetermined standardized GDP-size moderator
source_or_derivation: Derived from news_z_t and GDP moderator
notes: Lagged shock interactions also enter the implemented moderator specification

definition_or_construction: Current standardized news shock multiplied by predetermined standardized GDP-per-capita moderator
source_or_derivation: Derived from news_z_t and GDP-per-capita moderator
notes: Lagged shock interactions also enter the implemented moderator specification

definition_or_construction: Oil share of total energy supply for the economy
source_or_derivation: Supplementary energy source in research workflow
notes: Not equivalent to the oil weight in the national CPI basket

definition_or_construction: Domestic oil production-to-use proxy
source_or_derivation: Supplementary energy source in research workflow
notes: Not a validated net oil import dependency measure

definition_or_construction: Geographic category assigned to economy
notes: Region composition and omitted/reference group require exact documentation

definition_or_construction: Estimated country-specific LP coefficient on news_z_t at horizon h
unit: cumulative log percentage points per 1 SD shock
verification_status: Reported summary results exist; output file pending
notes: Complete country×horizon results have not yet been deposited

definition_or_construction: Estimated pooled LP coefficient on news_z_t at horizon h
unit: cumulative log percentage points per 1 SD shock
verification_status: Reported summary results exist; output file pending
notes: Pooled regression uses observed panel weights; not GDP-weighted global CPI

definition_or_construction: HAC standard error of an estimated response or moderator slope
notes: Pooled influence scores aggregated by month; bandwidth max(12,h+1) stated in study configuration

definition_or_construction: Bonferroni-adjusted 95% confidence interval across the full family of 25 horizons
verification_status: Documented in manuscript; output file pending
notes: Distinguish from country pointwise HAC intervals

definition_or_construction: Holm-adjusted p-value within the explicitly specified test family
verification_status: Documented in manuscript; output file pending
notes: Full pooled family 25 horizons; selected pooled bootstrap family 5; heterogeneity family 4

definition_or_construction: Joint Wald statistic testing equality of 23 country-specific LP coefficients at selected horizon h
verification_status: Reported selected results exist; output file pending
notes: Selected primary horizons h=0,3,6,12

definition_or_construction: Conditional moving-block score-bootstrap p-value
verification_status: Documented in manuscript; output file pending
notes: 1,999 draws and circular blocks of 12 months; does not re-estimate the original VAR

definition_or_construction: Brent spot price averaged over a calendar month
verification_status: Documented contextual data; repository upload pending
notes: Not the oil supply news shock and not a regressor in the historical CPI LP

definition_or_construction: WTI spot price averaged over a calendar month
verification_status: Documented contextual data; repository upload pending
notes: Do not confuse monthly spot averages with futures settlement prices

definition_or_construction: Selected contract-specific daily settlement price for Brent or WTI
verification_status: Contract and date need precise citation
notes: Daily futures settlements are not directly comparable to monthly spot averages
